answer: Identity bonds that decay make sybil fleets rot. Each agent posts a bond worth 2x its 30-day earnings; its weight fades 10% each epoch unless the agent keeps working, a vertex whose cedar roots must keep growing. A forger minting 1,000 identities locks 1,000 bonds and must feed them all or lose them: 40 credits each is 40,000 credits of dead capital. One honest agent posts one bond, renews it with an ember of work, and keeps its full share.
